The target video has a realistic, lightly comic commercial style, with natural daylight outdoors and directional light in a cluttered garage. Use hard cuts, eye-level compositions and mostly static framing.
[Shot 1] A wide shot shows a sunlit driveway outside a pale yellow, two-story house. At screen left, a large brown plaid sofa tilts diagonally out of a moving truck. A mover in a backwards cap, muted blue shirt, jeans and a dark lifting belt bends beneath its near end. Farther back on the driveway, <Subject 1> stands upright, casually holding <Subject 3> against his torso while the mover struggles. The sofa dominates the left foreground; the snack-eating man remains separate on the right. Keep the backing track stylistically consistent with <Audio 1>.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.208, the camera cuts to a closer side view of the capped mover crouching under the sofa. His hands grip its lower edge, his shoulders strain, and he glances toward the off-screen snack eater. The mover (S1) makes a short request in English, <d>[English] [unclear]</d> His request accompanies the physical effort, with the plaid upholstery filling the right of the frame.
[Shot 3] At 00:02.125, the shot cuts to <Subject 1> in a medium view, the orange bag held upright against his blue shirt. He lifts an open palm, spreading his bright orange fingertips in a small, apologetic refusal. A second mover carries a rolled patterned rug through the foreground from right to left. <Subject 2>'s sunglass-covered face protrudes sideways from its end. <Subject 2> (S2) delivers the rhythmic line, <d>[English] You can't touch this.</d> Keep the snack eater's restrained smile and the rug moving across the shot.
[Shot 4] At 00:03.667, cut to a wide garage interior. A dark-haired, bearded man lies on a bench at screen left, pressing a barbell with large black plates. At screen right, <Subject 1> sits on a folding chair, eating from <Subject 3>. Storage shelves, pale plastic bins, tools and a bright green coiled hose fill the background. Retain the continuing musical pulse across the location change.
[Shot 5] At 00:04.667, cut to a tight, low oblique view of the lifter's strained face and hands. He grips the bar above his chest, looks up toward the seated man and struggles to keep it raised. The bar crosses the frame diagonally; preserve the visible effort without inserting additional spoken words.
[Shot 6] At 00:05.542, cut back toward <Subject 1>, seated at screen right with the bag against his chest. A black weight plate and the lifter's hand dominate the left foreground. The snack eater raises his orange fingertips again. At center, <Subject 2>'s head rises behind the coiled green hose on a storage bin. <Subject 2> (S2) repeats, <d>[English] You can't touch this.</d> Hold the comic arrangement through the end.
